{{Quote|I am Skull Shatter. I speak with fire. Blood Scream bellows thunderous power. You&hellip; you are a pestilence.|Skull Shatter|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Skull Shatter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Esh-kha]] warrior who was born thousands of years ago during the height of his people's reign in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. During that time, the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] rallied its military might to end the marauding of the Esh-kha which saw the surviving members including Skull Shatter being imprisoned in [[Prison/Legends|stasis]] on the prison world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. He remained there for millennia until the [[Galactic War]] when his prison vault was broken open by an attack by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prison facility. Freed from imprisonment, Skull Shatter and his kin were determined to never be returned into the stasis prison again. Their berserker rampages led to them attacking both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces.

In this time, an official from the Empire was seeking to eliminating the threat posed by the Esh-kha. Whilst searching, the Imperial representative witnessed Skull Shatter arrive with a fellow warrior [[Blood Scream]] in order to attack a wounded Republic soldier party along with the Sith. However, he was ultimately slain in battle during this confrontation.
